# Security policy

Report security vulnerabilities affecting HYR Code through
[GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/HYRMedia-LLC/t3code/security/advisories/new).
Please do not disclose them publicly until we have had a reasonable opportunity to investigate and
remediate them.

HYR Code is an unofficial fork of T3 Code. Report vulnerabilities in upstream T3 Code or T3
Tools-operated services (such as T3 Connect or app.t3.codes) to T3 Tools as described in the
[upstream security policy](https://t3.codes/security-policy).
